cards.looks: A grid of white cards, about three per row, each with an optional picture or logo, a centred title and text with links inside the sentences, optional highlighted large text and optional fine print.
cards.use: Short notices or programme blurbs whose links sit inside the text, e.g. 'Missing Anniversaries … click here'.

fields.text: Rich text. Start with the title as a bold or heading line; put links inside the sentences.
fields.highlightText: Optional large text shown first, such as a figure or short phrase.
fields.disclaimer: Optional fine print under the text.
